about_the_game:
Meet Viktoria!

By day, Victoria knocks the nonsense out of Echo City's toughest thugs. By night, she curls up on the couch in her favorite robe and fluffy slippers. Who would've guessed the queen of the ring melts for cocoa with marshmallows and cheesy romance shows?

When it comes to sex, Victoria is gentle, affectionate and attentive. She likes things slow and tender — no rough stuff, no power play. Just care, closeness, and real intimacy. Sex with her feels like warm milk before sleep: soothing, calming, and full of quiet trust. Slip off Victoria's robe, and even the gloomiest night starts to feel a little warmer.


WHAT YOU'RE GETTING?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Victoria in her soft and snuggly homebody look. You can switch mascots anytime by opening your profile in-game and heading to the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
